messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy plan started for release/2026-03-23. Staged canary: API v1.14, runtime v2.3-rc, console 3.2, router 4.0-beta. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Please ack interlocks within 5m or bot will auto-advance. Links: https://deploys.redwood/release/2026-03-23

maria: Acking. Quick check — runtime v2.3 has KV eviction policy change. Need router header-split flag to be on for console passthrough. Can we pin router to 4.0-beta for this wave? :eyes:

kai: router pin OK from my side but console team needs to confirm eslint/metrics drift. ping @amanda

amanda: saw the console thin-client change earlier. Header-split flag is gated behind console-toggle-2026. I can flip in the canary shard once runtime is pinned. Will need a fallback path in case router rejects traffic.

linus: note: runtime v2.3 changes hot-kv layout — if KV eviction hits earlier, latency spikes observed in perf-run. My suggestion: start canary at 1% traffic, watch p50/p99, CPU, and KV eviction rate.

maria: agreed. rollback sentinel: any p99 > 600ms for 3 mins OR KV_eviction_rate > 5% sustained for 2 mins -> immediate rollback. Also manual hold accepted.

amanda: +1. I'll stand by for header-toggle. Can we get a quick smoke run before traffic shift? I'll run smoke against staging and paste results.

maria: paste uses:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/health -H \"x-test-client: thin\" -d '{\"prompt\":\"hello\"}' | jq '.latency_ms'
```

amanda: smoke results:
- 120ms
- 118ms
- 140ms
no errors. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary started -> shard=us-east-1a traffic=1% routes=api(runtime:2.3), router(4.0-beta)

deploy-bot: Canary metrics update (2m): p50=90ms p99=210ms errors=0 KV_eviction=0.8%

linus: looks fine so far. advise hold until router header-toggle is flipped. I'll hold the rollout from runtime side if needed. :hand:

amanda: header-toggle flipped on canary routers. command:
```
kubectl patch config header-split -n console --type=json -p '[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/enabled\",\"value\":true}]'
```

maria: flipping pin: API -> v1.14, runtime -> v2.3, router -> 4.0-beta. Release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-23

kai: rolling forward to 5% now. deploy-bot if any sentinel tripped, auto-rollback and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted -> 5%. metrics: p50=95ms p99=240ms errors=0.2% KV_eviction=1.1%

amanda: small increase but within sentinel. keep watching 10m window.

maria: quick checklist: release notes posted, canary health OK, console toggle ON, pin versions set. Any objections? If none, we'll proceed to 25% after 10m.

kai: no objections from runtime infra. :+1:

linus: watching logs, will chime if KV eviction trend rises. :eyes:

amanda: holding final go until post-canary telemetry looks stable. setting manual-hold until 1762418980 by leaving note here. :warning:

maria: manual hold acknowledged. tagging @releaseteam for visibility.

deploy-bot: Manual hold received. Auto-advance paused. To continue, react :white_check_mark: on this thread or send `deploy-bot continue 1762418765`.

maria: will react if stable. thanks all.
